level_names.admin1: region (вилоят), the Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region, the Districts of Republican Subordination, or the city of Dushanbe (OSM admin_level 4)

tips.plate/area-code/calling-code: plate region code (the last two digits at the right end; flag and TJ at the left: 01, 05, 10 Dushanbe … 04 Gorno-Badakhshan) or landline code (372 Dushanbe, four digits elsewhere, after +992) readable → `clues.py lookup plate|area-code <value> --country tj` + `board.py apply`; a Russian-style plate with the code over RT in a box at the right is the 1996–2010 format: `--kind plate-1996`
